name: Equation Escape
tagline: Solve to unlock the next door — a cooperative escape-room that runs entirely on linear equations.

steps.title: Lock the room
steps.text: Spread the five Door tiles in a line — each shows a locked equation puzzle. Place the Key cards face-down beside them.

steps.title: Draw a scenario
steps.text: Read a Scenario card aloud — a short story: fares, distances, ages, prices. The whole team translates it into an equation together.

steps.title: Solve as a team
steps.text: Any player may solve, but the solver must announce each inverse operation as they apply it — “minus seven from both sides”.

steps.title: Unlock the door
steps.text: A correct solution flips the Door tile and reveals the Key card beneath. Show the substitution check to bank the key.

steps.title: Timer pressure
steps.text: The sand timer runs per door. Beat it and the team banks a speed star; let it run out and the door re-locks with a harder equation.

steps.title: Escape!
steps.text: The team escapes by unlocking all five doors before the Master Timer ends. Tally speed stars to grade the escape: Bronze, Silver or Gold.

challenges.title: Inverse Narration
challenges.brief: Solve a full door while narrating every inverse operation — no silent steps allowed.

challenges.title: Substitution Check
challenges.brief: Prove a solution by substitution, out loud, for three doors in a row.

challenges.title: Word Problem Architect
challenges.brief: Write your own scenario card for the opposing team — it must solve to a positive integer, or you lose the points.

challenges.title: Gold Run
challenges.brief: Escape all five doors with at least four speed stars — every solution checked and narrated.

scorecard.scoring: 5 points per unlocked door, plus printed challenge points. Each speed star = 3 bonus points. Deduct 2 points per skipped narration.
